data.title: 11th Darb Zubaydah Caravan Sets Off with 265 Participants from 20 Countries
data.content:
Hail, November 25, 2026, SPA -- The 11th edition of the Darb Zubaydah Caravan set off on Tuesday in Faid Historic City. Organized by the Duroob Al-Qawafil Association in Hail Region, the event is part of an initiative launched by Governor of Hail Region Prince Abdulaziz bin Saad bin Abdulaziz to revive the region’s ancient caravan routes and those taken by European travelers.
    Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Duroob Al-Qawafil Association Abdulaziz bin Ibrahim Al-Obaidah welcomed the 265 participants from 20 countries at the caravan’s launch ceremony.
    He noted that the caravan introduces participants to one of the most significant routes in Hajj and Islamic history, once traveled by pilgrims, traders, and travelers. He added that the route bears evidence of Muslim ingenuity in constructing wells, pools, dams, stations, and water facilities that enabled travel and settlement in the desert.
    Participants also visited an accompanying exhibition featuring rare and precious stones discovered along Darb Zubaydah (Zubaydah’s trail).
    The participants will cover more than 60 kilometers over two days, traveling from Faid Historic City to Al-Jaffaliyah village on foot, on horseback, or by bicycle.
    -- SPA
